tex_content.html:
\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Continuity of $W_\xi $ away from surgery times] At every nonsurgery time $t$, the function $W_\xi $ is continuous. \end{claim}
Proof

\sketch Nearby slices are canonically identified. A fixed family of spanning disks gives upper semicontinuity, while comparison of the nearby metrics by a factor $1+\eta (|t-t'|)$ gives lower semicontinuity.

□
